title: Why customers don’t care about your payment technology
text: Medium Why customers don’t care about your payment technology | by Chinwe O. | Oct, 2026 | Medium Sitemap Open in app Sign up Sign in Medium Logo Get app Write Search Sign up Sign in Fintech Payments Financial Technology Startup Product Management Why customers don’t care about your payment technology Chinwe O. 1 min read · Oct 5, 2026 -- Listen Share Speculative ghostwriting sample - LinkedIn thought leadership for a fintech founder Your customers don’t care how sophisticated your payment infrastructure is. They care about three things: Did the payment go through? Was my money safe? How quickly can I access it? That’s something I had to learn the hard way. In fintech, it’s easy to get obsessed with the technology behind the product—APIs, integrations, transaction speeds, fraud detection, and everything happening behind the scenes. But customers don’t experience any of that. They experience the moment they click “Pay.” If that moment is slow, confusing, or unreliable, the technology doesn’t matter. The best fintech products aren’t necessarily the ones with the most impressive infrastructure. They’re the ones that make complicated financial processes feel simple and dependable.
